title: Key lifecycle audit exporter for multi-region residency and retention
creator: Nadia Ortiz
description: Deliver an automated export pipeline that bundles key lifecycle events, rotation receipts, and residency/retention metadata into tamper-evident audit artifacts. This task covers end-to-end integration across our KMS adapters and HSM-backed keys, mapping keys to customer residency tags, enforcing retention TTLs on audit bundles, and producing signed manifests suitable for external compliance reviewers. The exporter must support per-customer residency (region-specific storage), selective redaction of customer data, and a retention policy that mirrors customer retention settings so evidence is retained or expired according to contracted data residency/retention rules.
acceptance_criteria: Export pipeline produces one immutable audit bundle per key rotation event that includes: rotation metadata, KMS/HSM attestation (signed), residency tag, and retention TTL
Bundles are stored in the correct region-specific S3 vault based on customer residency tags and cannot be copied to another region without an admin export flow
Automated proof-of-rotation manifest format accepted by compliance: JSON manifest + HSM signature (PKCS#7) and SHA256 checksum
Exports can be triggered ad-hoc from Console and scheduled daily for high-volume customers
Retention expiration garbage-collection removes bundles only after verifying retention TTL and adding a deletion audit entry
End-to-end integration tests against staging KMS/HSM adapters and residency buckets exist and run in CI

implementation_notes: Use envelope format: manifest.json, rotation_receipt.pem, rotation_log.ndjson, checksums.sha256, and index.txt
Prefer HSM-signed receipts where key material is HSM-managed; fall back to KMS signing when HSM attestation unavailable
Store bundles in encrypted S3 with bucket-level replication disabled by default; replication allowed only via explicit admin workflow
Retention TTL is set on the bundle metadata and enforced by a GC worker that cross-checks customer retention policy service
Expose per-bundle signature verification endpoint in internal admin API for compliance teams
Design for idempotency: exporter must deduplicate by rotation event id to avoid duplicate bundles for replays
To minimize PII leakage include only key identifiers and residency tags; redact customer-facing resource names unless explicitly requested by customer export flow
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Synchronous export at rotation time vs async worker: chosen async to avoid adding latency to rotation flow. Rotation writes event to durable queue; worker assembles bundle.
HSM attestation vs KMS envelope signatures: support both. HSM preferred for keys bound to HSM; KMS used for software-managed keys to ensure coverage.
Region-local storage to meet residency: we will create per-region vaults to avoid cross-region exposure; this increases operational footprint but simplifies compliance.
Granular retention enforcement in storage vs central GC job: central GC chosen to simplify policy changes and to record deletion audits reliably

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: HSM device provisioning delay could block end-to-end testing. Mitigation: build KMS-signed path first and validate manifest consumers.
Risk: Incorrect residency mapping leads to incorrect storage location. Mitigation: add end-to-end residency mapping test and a residency-override admin check
Risk: Export artifacts contain PII. Mitigation: implement mandatory redaction pass and manual review toggle for ad-hoc exports
Risk: Unauthorized cross-region copy. Mitigation: disable bucket replication by default and require infra-approved admin export workflow
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Staging validation with KMS-signed manifests and residency buckets (w/ QA harness). Phase 2: Pilot with 3 compliance-heavy customers and enable HSM-signed receipts. Phase 3: General availability with Console export UI and scheduled exports. Monitor GTM feedback and retention GC behavior for 2 release cycles before broad rollout.
